svg.title: What an Audio or Video Analyzer Returns
svg.desc: A timeline of one recording with three tracks. Transcript: WebVTT with speakers separated by diarization, spoken words only. Key frames: video only. Segments: with segmentation and content categories, each section gets its own summary and fields. Set locales for languages. Analyzers: prebuilt-audioSearch returns a transcript and summary; prebuilt-callCenter adds sentiment, topics, people and companies; your own fields use generate or classify. Music and sound effects are not transcribed and don't become chapter markers.
